task.title: Evaluate Workbook performance targets
task.description: After the benchmark harness, optimized local mutation path, optimistic web behavior, and batched sync are complete, run the 500-task by 20-operation acceptance benchmark once. Report every latency, burst, Git-process, projection, storage, history-validation, and sync measurement against the approved targets. Do not continue tuning inside this task; if a target is missed, stop and create a separate evidence-backed architectural decision.
